Messages.Author: Miasmat
Messages.Body:
If Nickolai, The Survivor uses his special to go get  from one of my other minions, can he play Freak Drive on that action?

> Nickolai, The Survivor
> Sabbat: Nickolai may gain 1 level of any Discipline another of your ready vampires has at superior as a +1 stealth action that costs 1 blood
>
> Freak Drive
> Only usable at the end of a successful action (after resolving the action). This vampire untaps.
>
I guess it's similar to diablerizing an older vampire and getting a Fortitude skill card, then playing Freak Drive.

I'm pretty sure he can, since he gains the discipline after the action resolves (successfully).

Messages.Author: Brum
Messages.Body:
Yes, you can.
The cardtext on Freak Drive is explicit: "(after resolving the action)".
So, by the time you get to use Freak Drive, Nickolai already knows  , because the action has resolved.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Miasmat wrote:
> If Nickolai, The Survivor uses his special to go get  from one of my other minions, can he play Freak Drive on that action?
>
Yes. He has Fortitude at the end of the action (if it was successful).
>
> Miasmat wrote:
> I guess it's similar to diablerizing an older vampire and getting a Fortitude skill card, then playing Freak Drive.
>
> I'm pretty sure he can, since he gains the discipline after the action resolves (successfully).
>
Him gaining the level of discipline is the action's resolution. After that resolution, he has the new level of discipline.
